description: Android Fragment class 'ReceiptsList' that displays a list of receipts fetched from a remote API, using RecyclerView and Volley for network requests.

classes.name: ReceiptsList
classes.description: Android Fragment that manages and displays a list of receipts, fetching data from an API and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ReceiptsList fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes RecyclerView, and loads receipt data.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Fetches receipt data from remote API using Volley, updates the receipt list, and sets the RecyclerView adapter.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Replaces RecyclerView with a TextView indicating no receipts uploaded.
